mentions.name: Unmeshed
mentions.description: An orchestration platform that eliminates the glue code typically written for resiliency and connecting systems together, with an execution design flexible enough to serve as a real-time API orchestrator. It is a cost-optimized rewrite of Netflix Conductor and includes a managed SQLite service (as many as needed) so stateful workflows work without an external database provider; the company's own CRM, SaaS management, deployments, and finance tools are static HTML UIs built on top of it.
mentions.problem: Teams typically write glue code for resiliency or connecting systems together, and prior orchestration platforms rely on generous dependencies that drive up infrastructure costs.
mentions.audience: Developers building and connecting backend workflows
mentions.source_excerpt: Just crossed the second year building out Unmeshed - Orchestration Platform.
